get.summary: Get the active price levels visible to this API Key.
get.description:
Unlike the other lookups, price levels can be customer-specific. A scoped key sees
the dealer-wide levels (those with no CustomerID) plus any level owned by, or
assigned to, a customer in its access list. An AllAccess key sees every active level.

get.summary:
Retrieve paper consumption data for a customer within a date window.
Pass isBillable=1 to return only reads marked as WasUsedForBilling.
Pass isBillable=0 (or omit) to return all valid reads (actual volume).
Category buckets (B/W, Color, Duplex) are resolved dynamically from MTMeterTypeCategories.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The eAutomate Customer ID.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the date window (inclusive).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the date window (inclusive).

parameters.name: isBillable
parameters.description: 1 = billable reads only (WasUsedForBilling = 1), 0 = actual reads (default).

200.description: Returns usage records.

401.description: Invalid or missing API Key / insufficient claims.

403.description: This API Key does not have access to the requested customer.

put.summary: Create a new Sales Order via the ID634 import pipeline.
put.description:
Stages one row per line in ZCJ_ImpSOOrderDetails sharing a unique
SourceID, then invokes the ID634 stored procedure
(ZCJ_Event_634_Log) with that SourceID. The procedure derives the
header, creates the SOOrders / SOOrderDetails records, and writes
the resulting SOID back onto the staged detail rows.

200.description: Returns the created Sales Order header and detail rows

ApInvoiceRequest.description:
AP invoice / voucher creation request. Maps 1:1 to the JSON contract consumed by
dbo.WF_AP_InsertInvoice (@vs_JSON). One request = exactly one invoice.
The acting e-automate user id (@vs_UserID) is passed via the "eauserid" request header, not the body.

ModelMeterDto.description:
A row from MTModelMeters, as returned by dbo.MT_ModelMeters_List. The proc also
selects CreatorID / UpdatorID / CreateDate / UpdateDate; those are deliberately
not surfaced here, matching the ModelMeters entity.

ModelMeters.description:
Model meters. The CreatorID / UpdatorID / CreateDate / UpdateDate columns are
deliberately not mapped, so they are never selected or returned.

NoteType.description:
Note types. The CreatorID / UpdatorID / CreateDate / LastUpdate columns are
deliberately not mapped, so they are never selected or returned.
            
The eAutomate note-permission columns — PermittedUsers, PermitAllUsers and
IsEncrypted — are also unmapped. They gate which eAutomate users may read note
bodies inside the eAutomate client; API callers are not eAutomate users, the API
does not serve note bodies for these types, and advertising which note types hold
encrypted content has no consumer value.

code.description: The ShOnHoldCodes.OnHoldCode value — a member cannot share its type's name.
